none: PAS LEIC-EDD740: Roman? copper alloy object
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Roman or later fragment. The object has a half-ring shape and a D-section. The base is flat and undecorated. The opposite side has decorations consisting of dots inscribed within two lines running along the border of the object. The truncated base of a small shank is visible near the terminal part of the external side. It may be part of a buckle/strap or it could be a small belt…
